prompt: What was the age difference between the inventor of Barbie and the inventor of Hot Wheels?
answer: Ruth Handler (the inventor of Barbie) and Elliot Handler (the inventor of Hot Wheels) were born in the same year, 1916. Elliot was older by about **seven months**—he was born April 9, while Ruth was born November 4.
